name: Hot and Sour Soup
steps: Cut tofu into narrow strips and shred cabbage and carrot. Chop ginger, garlic, chilli and spring onion, keeping the greens aside. Mix cornflour with 50 ml cold measured water.
Heat oil and stir-fry ginger, garlic, chilli and onion whites for 1 minute. Add carrot and cabbage and cook for 3 minutes, stirring to keep their texture.
Add remaining water, tofu, soy sauce, white pepper and salt. Simmer for 6–8 minutes; stir the slurry again and pour it in while mixing to avoid lumps.
Simmer for 2 minutes until lightly thickened. Switch off and stir in vinegar, sesame oil and onion greens; taste for a balanced sharp and peppery finish and serve hot.
notes: Base recipe for 4 adults. Cooking times are estimates; follow the texture and doneness cues. Jain suitability follows your saved ingredient choices.
